industry_scenarios.title: Quote wholesale quantities without changing stock units
steps: Choose a reviewed trade price list.
Preview quantity and price before confirming an invoice.
acceptance_checks: Both demonstrated quantities meet the illustrative price threshold.
A price-list change does not rewrite a posted invoice.
Carton-to-piece conversions and landed costs remain future scenarios.

scenario.title: Review a trade sale and settlement
scenario.goal: Follow stock purchase, customer credit sale, partial collection, return and till-to-bank transfer.
steps: Receive the boxed supply purchase at its recorded unit cost.
Post the trade-customer invoice and inspect the stock issue and receivable.
Apply the named customer receipt, then review the remaining balance and return credit.
Compare the cash transfer with the cash-on-hand and bank accounts.
checks: A return is linked to the source invoice and does not create a second sale.
Customer and supplier balances remain in their respective control accounts.
The pack uses one stock location and does not claim pricing-list or sales-order functionality.
